def is_palindrome(s):
    """
    Return True if the string s reads the same forwards and backwards,
    ignoring case (uppercase/lowercase differences are ignored).

    Parameters
    ----------
    s : str
        The string to check.

    Returns
    -------
    bool
        True if s is a palindrome (case-insensitive), False otherwise.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> is_palindrome("racecar")
    True
    >>> is_palindrome("RaceCar")   # case ignored
    True
    >>> is_palindrome("hello")
    False
    >>> is_palindrome("")
